analysis:
At the Madhya Pradesh Global Investors Summit on 24 February 2025, Railway Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw said more than 97% of Indian Railways was already electrified and that 100% electrification was expected in FY 2025-26.

PIB reported about 99.2% of the broad-gauge network electrified as of November 2025 and about 99.6% as of July 2026; the residual stretches (574 route km, 0.8%, across five states at the end of 2025) remain under execution. The government states 100% electrification has been completed across 14 zones and 25 states/UTs.

The stated FY 2025-26 deadline (31 March 2026) passed without the network reaching 100%, so the claim is recorded as missed-deadline, while noting the network is close to completion.
notes: Vaishnaw has repeated the 100%-by-FY26 target at multiple venues; this entry uses the 24 February 2025 PIB release. Some later PIB statements from other ministers (e.g. Amit Shah, September 2026) describe 100% electrification as imminent rather than complete.
